title: Patch: the phone's match controls stay on one row, with the Marketplace inside a match menu
thread: **Issue #2645 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2645: Patch: the phone's match controls stay on one row, with the Marketplace inside a match menu Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ## What happens On a phone, the controls at the bottom of a match (End turn, Offer draw, Concede, the log toggle, Friends, the gear) are supposed to sit on **one row** (`board.css`, `@media (max-width: 600px)`: "One row of controls, End turn taking what the others leave: two rows cost the hand 50px"). Since the Marketplace shipped (R1853000–R1853003), they no longer hold together once the Marketplace opens in a game: - The Marketplace toggle (`apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.tsx`, `.marketplace-toggle` in `market.css`) is not part of the bar. It is a `position: fixed` 44px pill at `left: 12px; bottom: 12px`, so on a phone it sits on top of the bar's left end, which is End turn and Offer draw. - The row already had no room to spare: at 390×844 it "fits with a pixel to spare", and at 360–380px it only fits because gaps and padding tighten and Offer draw and Concede wrap their labels (`board.css`, the `max-width: 380px` block, #552). Every extra 44px control has had to be paid for by hiding another one (mute and language moved into the gear, #785; Friends hidden on the dev hotseat at ≤380px, #1831). - The panel is anchored to the pill (`bottom: calc(max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) + 52px)`), not to the bar, so it doesn't follow the bar when the bar grows a rail row or a notices row. So the bottom of a match on a phone now either stacks, overlaps or wraps, depending on width and which rail is showing. ## What should happen On every phone layout, the bottom controls sit on **one row**, and no button label wraps: no control overlaps another and the page never scrolls sideways, whether or not the Marketplace is open. Every control stays a 44px target (B29). The rows that already wrap on purpose (the notices strip with a draw offer or a refused action, the online or replay rail, the status line) still take a row of their own above the controls, as they do now. ## The fix: consolidate into a match menu Stop adding buttons to the row. On a phone (`max-width: 600px`, and the short landscape breakpoint `(orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 500px)` where the bar is also tight), the bar holds at most these, left to right: 1. **End turn** (with its clock), taking whatever width is left, as now. 2. **Marketplace**: an icon button (a coin or stall glyph, `aria-label` "Marketplace"), shown only while `view.marketplace` is present. This is the same toggle with the same `testid.marketplace`, moved into the bar on phones instead of floating over it. 3. **Log toggle**, as now. 4. **Match menu** (⋯, `aria-label` "Match menu", `aria-expanded`): a popover or sheet opening upward from the bar that holds **Offer draw**, **Concede** and **Friends**, each a full-width 44px row with its full label (so nothing wraps). 5. **The gear**, as now (it already holds Mute and Language there). That's five controls at most, four when there's no Marketplace, against the six or seven today, so the row fits at 320px without shrinking any label. The `max-width: 380px` workarounds that let Offer draw and Concede wrap (`white-space: normal`, `min-width: min-content`) and the rule that hides Friends on the dev hotseat go away. Details the builder must keep: - **Concede still only asks.** The menu's Concede calls the same `onControl("concede")`, so `ConfirmConcede` opens as now. Keep `testid.concede` and `testid.offerDraw` on the menu items, and make `refocusConcede` in `Game.tsx` fall back to the menu button when the Concede item isn't in the DOM (the menu closes when the dialog opens). - **Offer draw keeps its states.** Its label and title (`offerDrawText`: offered, pending, refused) show in the menu item. While a draw is offered *to* you, the notices strip still carries Accept and Decline, so nothing important is hidden behind the menu. The ⋯ button gets a dot while Offer draw has something to say. - **The Marketplace panel anchors to the bar** on phones: open it upward from the bar's top edge (measure the bar, or place it in the bar's stacking context) rather than a fixed `bottom: …52px`, so it clears a rail or notices row. Escape and Back (R2127000) close the panel and the match menu alike; only one of the two is open at a time. - **Tablet and desktop are unchanged.** They have a column with room, and Offer draw, Concede and Friends stay as buttons there. Decide whether the floating Marketplace pill moves into the bar there too; if it does, it must not overlap anything, and the 1280×720 board must look the same otherwise. - **The Duos board** (`duos.css`, its own card bar with Trade) and the **practice table** (`practice.css` restyles Offer draw) get the same treatment, so their bars stay on one row too. - The bar's highlight and animating props (`ControlButton`'s `highlight` and `animating`) still reach the items, so a tutorial that points at Concede or Offer draw points at the ⋯ button while the menu is closed. - The client still only sends intent (CLAUDE.md rule 7): the menu and the toggle render `view` and `legal` and decide nothing. - Any new label goes through `t()` with its Chinese string, as the bar's others do. ## Acceptance - `e2e/cypress/component/mobile-ux.cy.tsx`: for 320×568, 360×740, 375×667, 390×844, 412×915 and 844×390, with and without `view.marketplace`, and with a rail (online) and without one (practice, hotseat), every direct control of `.control-bar` shares one `offsetTop`, none is taller than one line (44px), none overlaps another or the Marketplace toggle, and `document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth`. - Unit tests (`apps/web/src/test/ux/board-ux.test.tsx` or alongside): the match menu opens and closes, holds Offer draw, Concede and Friends on a phone, and Concede from it opens `ConfirmConcede` without sending `concede`; Escape closes it; the Marketplace toggle renders inside the bar on a phone and only while `view.marketplace` is present. - The specs and tests that click `testid.concede` or `testid.offerDraw` at a phone viewport open the menu first; desktop specs are untouched. - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` and the component specs are green. ## How to reproduce 1. `pnpm --dir apps/web dev`, then open `/practice` (or `/dev/hotseat`) at 390×844 in the device toolbar. 2. Play a Stinkyscape deck until either player gains a Resource or Credits, which opens the Marketplace (R1853000). 3. Look at the bottom of the board: the Marketplace pill sits over End turn and Offer draw. At 360px, Offer draw and Concede break onto two lines; with an online rail the panel opens over the rail. Where: the client (`apps/web/src/game/Board.tsx`'s `.control-bar`, `Marketplace.tsx`, `market.css`, `board.css`, `practice.css`, `duos.css`). No engine, card or catalog work, and no fragment: this ships no card data. ## Plan _Written by `claude-2` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41265963593)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal On both phone layouts, `(max-width: 600px), (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 500px)`, the control bar holds only five controls: - End turn, with its clock; - the Marketplace toggle, only while `view.marketplace` is present; - the log toggle; - a new match menu (⋯); - the gear. ⋯ opens a menu upward from the bar. It holds Offer draw, Concede and Friends, each a full-width, one-line, 44px row. The Marketplace toggle and its panel move into the bar's DOM, and the panel opens from the bar's top edge. Desktop and tablet keep their buttons, and the desktop sidebar layout keeps the floating pill. Duos and practice inherit the change. The client still only sends intent (rule 7). ## Files to touch | Path | Kind | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/config.ts` | change | `PHONE_BAR_QUERY` | | `apps/web/src/game/phoneBar.ts` | new | `usePhoneBar()` | | `apps/web/src/game/MatchMenu.tsx` | new | ⋯ and its menu | | `apps/web/src/game/contract.ts` | change | `testid.matchMenu`, `testid.matchMenuPanel`, `BoardProps.market` | | `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.tsx` | change | open state passed in by the caller; icon and label on the toggle | | `apps/web/src/game/Board.tsx` | change | menu and shop state; a phone branch and a desktop branch of the bar | | `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx` | change | a `market` prop instead of drawing ``; `refocusConcede` fallback | | `apps/web/src/together/FriendsButton.tsx` | change | a `"menu"` placement that shows a label | | `apps/web/src/game/board.css` | change | the menu's rules; drop the phone Friends rules and the 380px label-wrap rules; landscape column in two rows | | `apps/web/src/game/market.css` | change | toggle in the bar; panel positioned against the bar; floating pill only on the sidebar layout | | `apps/web/src/duos/duos.css` | change | hide ⋯ when the menu holds no Friends button | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | `"Match menu"` | | `apps/web/src/test/phoneBar.ts` | new | `stubPhoneBar()` test helper | | `apps/web/src/test/ux/board-ux.test.tsx` | change | new #2645 tests; rewrite the #1831 CSS tests; drop one #990 assertion | | `apps/web/src/together/FriendsButton.test.tsx` | change | one #2645 test | | `e2e/cypress/component/mobile-ux.cy.tsx` | change | B29 opens the menu first; new #2645 describe | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | the Marketplace paragraph and a match-menu paragraph | Do not touch: - `crates/` and `spec/`: this is layout, so there is no ruling. - `practice.css`: its `.practice-table .control-bar .control-offer-draw` rule already hides the menu's Offer draw row. - `e2e/support/` and the specs in `e2e/cypress/e2e/`: they all run at 1280×720. - `.github/`, `.harness/` and `bot/`. - No fragment. What governs the change: - SPEC §10.10 and R1853003 (the Marketplace is a button on the board). - R2127000 (Back closes overlays). - R2126000 (the board's key handlers are frozen by a census test). - R36 (Offer draw's blocked text). - B29 in `docs/polish/7-mobile-ux.md` (44px touch targets). - CLAUDE.md rules 7 and 9. ## Steps 1. **`game/config.ts`**: append this constant: ```ts /** #2645: board.css's two phone layouts, where the control bar keeps to one row. */ export const PHONE_BAR_QUERY = "(max-width: 600px), (orientation: landscape) and (max-height: 500px)"; ``` 2. **`game/phoneBar.ts`** (new): copy the shape of `game/useOsReducedMotion.ts`. The header names #2645 and rule 7. - `queryList()` returns `window.matchMedia(PHONE_BAR_QUERY)` inside a try/catch, or null. - `subscribe(onChange)` adds a `"change"` listener and returns the function that removes it. - `isPhone()` returns `queryList()?.matches === true`. - Export: ```ts export function usePhoneBar(): boolean { return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, isPhone, () => false); } ``` 3. **`game/contract.ts`**: - Import the `ActionBody` type. - In `testid`, after `marketplacePanel`, add `matchMenu: "match-menu", matchMenuPanel: "match-menu-panel",` with a #2645 doc comment. - In `BoardProps`, add: ```ts /** R1853003: the Marketplace's shop, drawn in the control bar (#2645); absent (a replay), none. */ market?: { legal: readonly ActionBody[]; onAction: (body: ActionBody) => void }; ``` 4. **`game/MatchMenu.tsx`** (new): - Signature: `export default function MatchMenu({ open, onOpenChange, dot, glow, animating, children }: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void; dot: boolean; glow?: string; animating?: string; children: ReactNode })`. - The header says: - it decides nothing (rule 7); - it stays mounted while closed (`hidden`), so a Friends panel opened from it survives the menu closing; - a press on an item, ⋯, Escape and Back (R2127000) close it. - Body setup: call `useLocale()`, set `menuId = useId()`, and make refs `button` and `menu`. Then add: ```ts const close = useCallback(() => { onOpenChange(false); button.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, [onOpenChange]); ``` - The ⋯ button is `}`; - practice, using `practice-table.cy.tsx`'s wrapper; - hotseat, using `mountHotseat`'s wrapper. - Each `it` checks the route without a marketplace, then remounts with `{ ...fullBoardView(), marketplace: { offers: [], sales: [] } }` and checks again. - The check runs `cy.document().should(...)` over End turn plus every shown `button` child of `.control-bar`. It asserts: - end-turn, log-toggle, match-menu and settings-open-game are present, and `marketplace-button` is present exactly when the view has a marketplace; - offer-draw, concede, friends-button and audio-toggle are absent; - every control is 44±0.5px tall and at least 44px wide; - in portrait, all tops are within 1px of each other; - at 844×390, end-turn and the gear share a top, and the rest share one top below it; - no two controls overlap, and `scrollWidth <= width`. - Add two more tests: - `#2645 at 360x740 the match menu opens above the bar with Offer draw and Concede on one 44px line each, inside the screen`. - `#2645 at 390x844 with a rail the Marketplace panel opens above the bar's top edge, inside the screen`. Run, in order: 1. `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` 2. `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/test/ux/board-ux.test.tsx src/together/FriendsButton.test.tsx src/game/Marketplace.test.tsx src/game/Board.test.tsx src/shortcuts/shortcuts.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` 3. `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` and `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck:component` 4. `pnpm --dir e2e exec cypress run --component --browser chrome --spec cypress/component/mobile-ux.cy.tsx`. If the Cypress binary is missing, run `pnpm --dir e2e exec cypress install` first. If it still cannot run, report that rather than calling the spec green. ## Done when - [ ] The phone bar holds exactly the five controls, with the toggle only while `view.marketplace` is present. Desktop and tablet are unchanged, and the Board snapshot is untouched. - [ ] The menu works: - Concede only asks. - Offer draw keeps its states, and ⋯ shows the dot. - Escape, Back and item presses close the menu. - The menu is never open together with the shop. - Focus falls back to ⋯. - [ ] The panel opens from the bar, and Duos and practice still hide the items their CSS hides. - [ ] All the tests above pass and the harness checks are green, or the component spec is reported as not run. ## Risks - **Snapshot**: keep the desktop markup order exactly as it is. - **R2126000 census**: add no `onKey*` prop in the touched game files, and never raise a count in `shortcuts.test.tsx`. - **Friends panel**: it survives the menu closing only because the menu is `hidden`, not unmounted. Never render the menu's children conditionally. - **Padding**: `padding: 0` on both toggles is what beats the padding from `.app-shell button`. - **B33**: board.css must declare no px width over 390. - **Rule 7**: the menu and the toggle read only `view`, `highlight` and `legal`. - **R-ids in test titles**: put none in new test titles, or `spec check` would expect a `proven_in` entry for them. ## Open questions 1. **844×390 cannot be one row.** The landscape controls sit in a 176px column. End turn's housing plus four 44px buttons need 250px. The plan uses two rows there instead: End turn and the gear, then the rest. That is down from three rows today. So the one-top check runs in portrait only. A person may prefer to widen the column, which would take about 74px from the field. 2. **End turn's own label can still wrap** inside its 44px button at 320–375px, for example "Confirm end turn", under the existing #815 rule. "No label wraps" holds for Offer draw, Concede and Friends. 3. **The pill floats only on the sidebar layout.** On tablet portrait and between 601 and 760px wide, the toggle sits in the bar, because the floating pill overlapped the bar there too. 4. **Escape comes from `useModalKeys`.** It also keeps Tab cycling inside the open menu. The alternative, a new `onKeyDown`, is forbidden by R2126000's census. The menu does not close on a press outside it, and the shop does not either. ````
